fields.description: What every replica of this deployment serves. Set once — the gateway routes on it.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: The image every replica serves from. Deployment-only — a replica on a different image would answer to the same model name with a different engine.
fields.label: Engine Image

fields.description: What is inside the image. Shown so the form can hide what does not apply.
fields.label: Engine Kind

fields.description: How many GPUs ONE replica takes. Drives tensor parallel size, and is what the scheduler looks for when it places a replica.
fields.label: GPUs per Replica

fields.description: Optional hard filter for placement, matched against the Machine's GPU inventory (e.g. NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3). Blank places on any card.
fields.label: GPU Model

fields.description: Optional hard filter for placement, per card. Also what the weights-fit check is run against — blank skips that check rather than blocking.
fields.label: Min VRAM (GB)
Placement Policy
fields.description: How the scheduler ORDERS boxes that can already take a replica — it never makes an unsuitable box suitable. balanced: reuse a warm box, then spread across regions, then leave big boxes whole. pack: fill a box before opening another. spread: availability first, even off a warm box.
Stages to split the model's layers across (--pipeline-parallel-size). 1 = pure tensor parallel. Must divide GPUs per Replica evenly.
fields.label: Pipeline Parallel Size

fields.description: Derived = GPUs per Replica / pipeline parallel size. → --tensor-parallel-size.
fields.label: Tensor Parallel Size

fields.description: Defaults for every replica. A replica may override the knobs that are genuinely about its box; blank on the replica means it inherits from here.
fields.label: Hardware Tuning

fields.description: → --kv-cache-dtype. fp8 halves the KV cache, which buys context on a card short of VRAM, at some accuracy.
fields.label: KV Cache Dtype

fields.description: → --gpu-memory-utilization (0-1).
fields.label: GPU Memory Utilization

fields.description: → --max-num-batched-tokens. Blank = vLLM's own default.
fields.label: Max Num Batched Tokens

fields.description: → --max-num-seqs, and the gateway's admission cap per replica. A replica that overrides this reports its own number to the route table; one that leaves it blank reports this one.
fields.label: Max Num Seqs

fields.description: → --max-model-len. Blank = 8192. Takes a suffix — 32k, 128k, 1m — or a plain token count.
fields.label: Max Model Len

fields.description: → VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1. Deployment-only: a Check cannot express 'inherit', and a wrong value gives garbage output instead of an error.
fields.label: Allow Long Max Model Len

fields.description: Deployment-only, except Extra Serve Args. These decide what the service advertises and what the compile cache is keyed on — replicas differing here would answer one model name with different engines.
fields.label: Extra

fields.description: Arguments for a custom image's own entrypoint. Each is passed as one argument, so nothing reaches the shell.
fields.label: Startup Command

fields.description: Path polled until it answers 200 before a deploy is called done. Blank uses the engine kind's own.
fields.label: Health Path

fields.description: Freeform extra `vllm serve` flags appended verbatim. A replica may append its OWN on top of these — vLLM takes the last occurrence of a repeated flag, so a replica can add to this or override one of its flags without retyping the rest.
fields.label: Extra Serve Args

fields.description: What a replica of this deployment runs, from the same builder the deploy uses. A replica that overrides a knob renders its own — this is the shape they share.
fields.label: Serve Command

fields.description: Layered on top of the vars Grove derives. A replica's own rows layer on top of these again, so a replica adds to this rather than replacing it.
fields.label: Environment Variables
